newsitem.title: USA: U.S. urges citizens to be cautious at Serbia demos.
newsitem.headline: U.S. urges citizens to be cautious at Serbia demos.

text.p: The United States on Friday urged its citizens to "exercise caution" near opposition demonstrations in Serbia because of possible clashes between protesters and police.
There have been daily demonstrations in Belgrade and other Serbian cities since authorities cancelled victories by the opposition Zajedno coalition in Nov. 17 local elections.

"Clashes between demonstrators and police have occasionally resulted in severe injuries," a State Department public announcement said. "American citizens are urged to exercise caution around all such demonstrations and rallies."

U.S. officials say that in the past week, Serbian police have increasingly resorted to tough tactics against the demonstrators. Washington has condemned police violence and called on Serbia to reinstate the election results.
